attributes.board_name: Hawaii Board of Pharmacy (DCCA Professional and Vocational Licensing)

rules.alternatives: Technicians approved to administer vaccines (HRS § 461-11.4) have separate training requirements for that privilege.
rules.notes: Registration renews without a CE requirement. Registration has been required since January 1, 2026 (HRS § 461-9.5, Act 93 of 2025); certificates are valid through December 31 of each odd-numbered year. Act 36 (2026, SB 2623) made them renewable and states that the Board shall not require proof of continuing education from pharmacy technicians.
rules.rule_quote: …provided that for certificates of registration for pharmacy technicians, the board shall not require proof of continuing education.
